description: The status of a GPFR registration. Without a code it emails a one-time code to the registered address, with the code it returns one status word. At most 3 emails a day per address.

code.description: Optional. The six-digit code from our email to the registered address.

language.description: Optional. Default en. GPFR is live in 24 languages: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh. bg, uk, vi are answered in English.

name: gpfr_status
title: GPFR: status, with a one-time code
